component.name: DMX Lighting
component.summary: Drive DMX lighting from your OBS scenes

description.p: Attach a lighting program to each OBS scene: a static look, a chaser, a strobe, or an effect that follows the audio playing in OBS. Output over Art-Net, sACN or a USB DMX interface.
Beats are now found in dense, loud and fast music, a chase set to run on the beat actually does, and the sensitivity of the detection can be set from the interface while watching the level meter.
